items.quote: 18 minutes a day. That’s all it takes to outperform 95% of people in your field. Sounds too simple?
items.statement: 18 minutes a day is all it takes to outperform 95% of people in your field.

items.quote: But the ones who win? They don’t hustle 24/7. They show up for 18 focused minutes a day.
items.statement: The ones who win show up for 18 focused minutes a day consistently.

items.quote: You don’t need to be the most talented. You just need to keep going longer than those who stop.
items.statement: You don’t need to be the most talented; you just need to keep going longer than those who stop.

items.quote: The answer: Just 100 hours per year. That’s 18 minutes a day.
items.statement: You can become better than 95% of people in any given profession with just 100 hours per year.

items.quote: If you’re still here — you’re already closer than you think.
items.statement: If you’re still here — you’re already closer than you think.

overview: A LinkedIn post discussing the importance of focused daily practice for success.
